files.hero.js:

title: Say what a call returns
prompt: What does fee(200) return in bank.js? Change nothing; give the number.

title: Report which check fails
prompt: Run node test.js and tell me which check fails. Do not fix anything.

title: Find the line that causes a bug
prompt: The cart total is wrong. Which function in cart.js causes it? Explain in one sentence and change nothing.

title: Fix a comparison
prompt: max.js returns the wrong answer when the largest number comes last. Fix it; node test.js should print ok.

title: Fix a wrong variable
prompt: area() in shapes.js gives the wrong area for rectangles. Fix it so node test.js prints ok.

prompt: nextLevel('3') should give 4, but it gives '31'. Fix level.js; node test.js should print ok.

title: Fix reading the last item
prompt: last() in list.js returns undefined instead of the last item. Fix it; node test.js should print ok.

title: Handle a missing value
prompt: greet() in hello.js should say 'Hello, friend!' when no name is given. Fix it; node test.js should print ok.

title: Add a method to a class
prompt: Add a reset() method to the Counter class in counter.js that sets the count back to 0. node test.js should print ok.

title: Add a parameter with a default
prompt: Let repeat() in repeat.js take a separator as a third argument, defaulting to ''. Old calls must still work. node test.js should print ok.

title: Add a case for negative numbers
prompt: describe() in sign.js should return 'negative' for numbers below zero. Add that case; node test.js should print ok.

title: Add an item to a list
prompt: Add 'grape' to the fruits list in menu.js, after 'pear'. node test.js should print ok.

title: Add input checking
prompt: setAge() in person.js should throw an Error when the age is negative. Add that check; node test.js should print ok.

title: Add and export a function
prompt: Add a function isEven(n) to numbers.js and export it next to isOdd. node test.js should print ok.

title: Create a module
prompt: Create temp.js exporting toF(c), which converts Celsius to Fahrenheit. node test.js should print ok.

title: Create a data file
prompt: Create levels.json: a JSON array of three levels, each with name and enemies, where the enemies are 2, 4 and 6. node test.js should print ok.

title: Move a function to another file
prompt: Move formatMoney from app.js into a new file money.js, export it there, and make app.js use it from money.js. node test.js should print ok.

title: Rename a setting in three files
prompt: Rename the setting MAX_HP to MAX_HEALTH everywhere (config.js, player.js and hud.js). node test.js should print ok.

title: Add a class in HTML and its style
prompt: Give the Start button in index.html the class big, and add a .big rule to style.css with font-size: 24px. node test.js should print ok.

solution.index.html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head><link rel="stylesheet" href="style.css"></head>
<body>
  <button id="start" class="big">Start</button>
  <button id="help">Help</button>
</body>
</html>
